entities.name: Query RNase P protein
observations: 109 aa protein sequence; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q6MRS3 from Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides SC.
Predicted molecular weight is 12,912 Da, theoretical pI 10.30, and charge at pH 7 is +19.48.
Pfam Ribonuclease_P domain PF00825.25 spans residues 1–108 with i-Evalue 1.2e-28.
Strongly basic composition is consistent with RNA binding; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide was indicated by the analysis.

entities.name: RNase P protein component
observations: Reviewed annotations describe an auxiliary protein subunit of bacterial RNase P that binds the pre-tRNA 5'-leader and broadens substrate specificity of the catalytic RNA component.
RNase P functions with an M1/rnpB catalytic RNA component to remove 5'-leader sequences from pre-tRNA; 4.5S RNA can also be a substrate.
Associated Gene Ontology terms include ribonuclease P complex, tRNA binding, ribonuclease P activity, and tRNA 5'-leader removal.

entities.name: Q6MRS3
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot reference from Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides SC; exact sequence hash match to the query, 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Annotated as the ribonuclease P protein component.
